svg.title: Five vision models, one release process
svg.desc: Five-model vision stack in a uv and DVC monorepo with hashed, benchmarked, A/B-gated releases.
svg.text: Five vision models, one release process
Meter presence, oriented dial detection, digital/analog and OCR in one uv + DVC monorepo.
Every release is hashed, benchmarked and A/B-gated before it ships.
